note: Set A binds every value correctly, notably calling the thruster firing interval a period (not a frequency), and cleanly captures the filter passbands (0.45–1.0 µm at nominal distance, 0.45–0.67 µm for UV science), the 1.0 µm astro-coating response limit, the 47→1330 f/# change, field stops, 1 kHz readout and ~1 s data suspension. Set B does recover three quantitative facts A omits (EMCCD at 153 K, the 11.9" imaging field stop, and the ~7e-3 central-spot intensity at 1.7 µm), but it twice mislabels the firing interval as a 'frequency' with a value in seconds and includes a garbled, incomplete sub-systems claim whose quote is jumbled figure labels. Both sets pad with trivial figure-label claims and duplicates (A's are loosely bound to the chapter title, B's to the visible channel), so the deciding difference is that A has no misread or misbound values while B has three. On balance A is the more faithful extraction, though B's coverage of the detector temperature and field stops is a real advantage.
